defaultItem.title: Clean water for the whole home
defaultItem.description: We are a family-owned Scottsdale company engineering custom filtration for Arizona’s hard water. Protect your family and your pipes.

defaultItem.heading: Know your water
defaultItem.paragraph: Hard water scales your pipes and cuts your water heater life in half. Chlorine dries your skin and you breathe it in during hot showers.

subFeatures.title: Calcium & magnesium
subFeatures.text: Destroys appliances from the inside and leaves chalky residue on fixtures.

subFeatures.title: Municipal chlorine
subFeatures.text: Strips natural oils from skin and degrades indoor air quality.

defaultItem.heading: Whole house water system
defaultItem.description: We don’t sell generic boxes off a shelf. We engineer a targeted 6-stage system scaled for your home’s exact water chemistry.

stages.title: Stage 1 — Sediment pre-filter
stages.text: Intercepts sand, silt and visible particles so downstream stages stay clean.

stages.title: Stage 2 — Ion-exchange softening
stages.text: Resin exchanges calcium & magnesium — removes hardness (Arizona 15–25 gpg) without adding sodium.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Carbon — chlorine & chemicals
stages.text: Activated carbon strips chlorine and DBPs that dry skin and off-gas in hot showers.

stages.title: Stage 4 — Heavy metals & arsenic
stages.text: Targeted media removes heavy metals and arsenic from every drop.

stages.title: Stage 5 — Bacteria & pesticides
stages.text: Purification barrier removes bacteria and pesticides for safe water at every faucet.

stages.title: Stage 6 — pH balance & polish
stages.text: Final polish balances pH, self-cleaning — no filters to change, pure at every tap and appliance.

defaultItem.heading: Water treatment designed around Arizona homes.
defaultItem.paragraph: We’re a family business rooted in Scottsdale. For nearly two decades we’ve tested the Valley’s hardest water — well and municipal — and built systems that actually fix it.

stats.label: Years in Scottsdale

stats.label: On-site testing
stats.text: One local crew, one lab-verified test at your tap, no subcontracted sales team.

stats.label: Custom for Arizona
